verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own accounting sync: one-click accounting setup with automatic expense-data sync to Puzzle, plus an Accounting API for connecting to an accounting system and positioning around real-time close. Departments, cost centers, and custom dropdown fields exist as structures, but nothing shows them mapped to GL coding in a sync. missing for 10: any evidence of sync to QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero specifically; user-controlled GL account, class, and department mappings; hands-on or independent corroboration.
